notes.title: BeatShips leaves Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
Thank you all who have been following us throughout the development of the game.
We have finally reached our objectives for this stage, so it is time to officially announce that we are LEAVING EARLY ACCESS!
Of course, this does not mean we will no longer improve the game, so don't stop sending your suggestions to us!!

[b]1.0 version brings 30 new levels and more enemies, along with the Rocket and the UFO as new playable ships.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34837015/7d3770f0ddae415da6e63f15f58a8fb4ae348fab.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy the new content!
- BeatShips Team

Remember to follow us in [url=https://discord.gg/BxGNDfN]Discord[/url] to get new levels and share yours.

notes.title: Update QoL + Summer Sale -40% Combo!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34837015/b2f35f683dab4e2ad91baca87399f53ec321055f.gif[/img]

[h1]Update and Sale![/h1]

Quality of Life update is going to be live at the same time Steam Summer Sales fire off! We are really excited to finally be able to show all the work we have been doing. So, here is the list of everything:

[list]
[*] Tutorials!
[*] UI Unification
[*] UI Animations and Transitions
[*] New Reactive Hud
[*] New Depth Perception System
[*] Achievements!
[*] Resolution Selector
[*] FPS Limiter
[*] Localization (English/Spanish)
[*] Better Controller Support and Practices
[*] Steam Rich Presence Integration
[*] Trello Suggestions and BugTracking Integration
[*] Level Progress Tracker
[*] Skins affect lots of things!
[*] New Level Selector with more or less cool effects
[*] Way better Level Editor UI
[*] Level Editor - Try Level - button to try your level while editing it!
[*] Feedback on missed enemies
[*] Backgrounds change! (randomly)
[/list]

There are less important things not listed here, and a hell of bugs that would require several pages to enumerate.

[h1]That's all, thank you for your time![/h1]

Remember to follow us in [url=https://discord.gg/BxGNDfN]Discord[/url] to get new levels and share yours. Also check our [url=https://twitter.com/beatships]Twitter[/url] for news and announcements.

notes.title: Launch Day Discount! 20% Off
notes.notes:
[h1]BeatShips is now Live![/h1]

We are excited to finally be able to share our game with the world, and we want the maximum amount of people playing this first days.

That is why [b]we are launching with a 20% discount![/b] This will last for a week, so if you like the game, please [b]share it with your friends[/b] as soon as possible so they can benefit of this discount too.


Thank you very much for your support.

notes.title: Discord server now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello world!

We just created a brand new Discord server that we plan to use as the main community hub for the game. It will also be the main method to share and download community levels (when the game launches).

Come to hang out or ask us anything, we are truly happy to hear anything you want to tell us!

Link: https://discord.gg/BxGNDfN
